faq.title: What I am asked most often.
faq.1.q: Does the furniture or the room change?
faq.1.a: No. Same room, same furniture, same framing. Only light, colours, white balance, verticals and sharpness are corrected. Every photo is compared with the original before delivery.
faq.2.q: Is this allowed on Airbnb and Booking?
faq.2.a: The platforms ask that photos show the property as it is. Correcting light and colour respects that rule. Adding objects or furniture would not: I never add any.
faq.3.a: 48 hours after I receive the link to your listing, photos and video included.
faq.4.a: High-resolution JPEG photos, ready to upload to Airbnb, Booking or Gîtes de Wallonie, and an MP4 video in landscape (website) and portrait (Instagram, TikTok).
faq.5.a: You pay after receiving the files, by bank transfer. No subscription, no hidden fees: €199, once.
